text: Checked t=0, K=1/2 one-address toy: a fixed constant-output machine satisfies weak query-domain Lipschitzness and a positive-distance strict variant; induced kernels preserve output law, yet one induced kernel fails Lean Oracle.lipschitz against an outside kernel. This does not satisfy or refute literal paper Definition 6.1 and does not refute Theorem 6.2.
